question: The Ganesh-rath is one of the finest monolithic temples located in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahabalipuram.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ganesh-rath** is located in** Mahabalipuram, **a town in the state of **Tamil Nadu** in India.
 
• It is a **monolithic temple**, which means it is carved out of a **single piece of rock.**
 
• The temple is dedicated to **Lord Ganesh**, who is worshipped as the god of **wisdom, knowledge, and new beginnings.**
 
• The Ganesh-rath is considered to be one of the finest examples of **Pallava architecture,** which flourished in southern India in the** 7th and 8th centuries AD.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Somnath** is a town in the state of Gujarat and is known for the **Somnath temple**, which is one of the **12 Jyotirlingas **(sacred abodes of Lord Shiva) in India.
 
• **Varanasi,** also known as **Kashi,** is a city in the northern state of Uttar Pradesh and is considered to be one of the **oldest continuously **inhabited cities in the world.
 
• **Nagpur** is a city in the **central state of Maharashtra **and is known for its oranges and as the geographical center of India.
